 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Serbisyopubliko Serbisyo Publiko WALANG PASOK: Class suspensions for Tuesday, November 3, 2026 
 By GMA News Published November 2, 2026 10:38pm 
 Updated November 2, 2026 11:55pm + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. Classes in some areas and schools for Tuesday, November 3, 2026 have been suspended due to the heat index.
 Below are the class suspensions:
 Mulanay, Quezon : all levels, public and private
 Himamaylan, Negros Occidental : all levels, public and private
 Hinigaran, Negros Occidental - all levels, public and private schools
 Schools and Universities
 Carlos Hilado Memorial State University - shift to online asynchronous learning on November 3 – 4 and November 6
 University of the Philippines Visayas - Iloilo City campus will shift to remote/ asynchronous
 Refresh this page for updates. — LDF/BAP, GMA News
